'''Ceraxian's Comet''' was a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the tomb of an [[Unidentified prince (Ceraxian's Comet)|ancient prince]] who was given a burial in space, and its interior was filled with treasures.<ref name="Tomb">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The Blazing Tomb}}</ref>
